text_block_list.text:
Having lost to Мистер Си Би last time, Eishin
Flash
cannot hide her anxiety upon
meeting her again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, I tell her how setbacks are a
valuable
experience that benefit her in
the long run. She
puts her faith in my
words and heads to the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although she loses the race, Мистер Си Би

acknowledges her abilities and confirms
that she
has improved.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Seeing her schedule through to
completion has
borne fruit. Эйсин Флэш
regains confidence in her
current
abilities and sets her determined gaze

upon the Osaka Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
